items.title: Saylor's "We're Back" message boosts market sentiment
points: MicroStrategy leader Michael Saylor posted a "We're Back" message signaling renewed commitment to the company's Bitcoin-accumulation strategy
Market participants interpreted the statement positively, reinforcing confidence in continued Bitcoin holding by major corporate investors
Large corporate Bitcoin holders like MicroStrategy act as sentiment indicators, and their leadership communication can move prices independent of underlying fundamentals

items.title: Fogo Foundation halts mainnet after $3M token compromise
points: A $3M exploit affected 400M tokens (10% of total supply), prompting Fogo Foundation to halt its mainnet (the live blockchain network)
Validators are upgrading software to restrict the compromised addresses, but no restart timeline has been given

items.title: Bitwise Solana Staking ETF surpasses $1B AUM
points: Bitwise's BSOL ETF (an exchange-traded fund that stakes Solana to earn yield) hit $1B in assets under management just 10 months after launch
It now captures over 50% of all Solana ETF assets, despite the ETF trading 40% below its listing price and SOL itself trading 60% below its all-time high
Cumulative spot Solana ETF trading volume has exceeded $13B since September 2025, with $1.7B in net inflows and no major outflow period
Charles Schwab plans to add spot Solana trading, and Goldman Sachs holds roughly $90M in spot Solana ETFs, making it the largest known institutional holder

items.title: 24/7 stock perpetual trading expands on crypto platforms
points: Bybit launched round-the-clock perpetual options (derivatives with no expiry date that track an asset's price) on SpaceX and Nvidia starting September 17, with fractional lots and USDT settlement
Tesla, QQQ, SOXL, and Micron are planned next; Coinbase, Kraken, and Robinhood are also pushing 24/7 equity trading
Tokenized-equity perpetual volume (contracts that mimic stock ownership on a blockchain) surged from $85B in January to $470B in June, with SpaceX the most-traded name

items.title: x402 stablecoin payment protocol scales for AI agents
points: The x402 protocol, enabling sub-$0.01 stablecoin payments for machine-speed API calls, processed 169M payments in its first year across ~590K buyers and 100K sellers
AWS, Cloudflare, and Google independently integrated native x402 support after governance moved to the x402 Foundation under the Linux Foundation, without Coinbase's involvement

Because AI agents operate on subsecond timescales incompatible with traditional banking rails, HTTP-native stablecoin payments are seen as a structural necessity, with projections of 80 billion AI-agent economic participants within a decade

items.title: Helium Network token HNT doubles after Texas municipal Wi-Fi integration
points: HNT's value doubled after Celina, Texas integrated municipal Wi-Fi into the Helium Network for cellular offload coverage without deploying new towers

items.title: Social trading platforms reach consumer scale
points: Fomo and Pump reached 60K-100K daily active users, matching Polymarket and Hyperliquid, and account for roughly one-third of all builder code volume on Hyperliquid

Pump has distributed over $450M to deployers (token launchers), equal to 15% of Meta's entire 2025 creator payout total, while memecoin traders pay 2-3% per swap (20-30x higher than spot exchange fees)

The platforms' core challenge is shifting from speculative onboarding into broader social finance uses like tokenized stocks and stablecoin savings, complicated by brand names that signal risk-seeking rather than wealth stewardship
